desc: Analyze the functional graph structure and derive exactly how cycle contraction transforms the inequalities.
Design the tree DP state for counting assignments of each contracted component for every possible assigned value.
Derive efficient transitions using cumulative sums so each tree edge costs \(O(M)\), not \(O(M^2)\).
Handle multiple connected components and combine their independent counts modulo \(998244353\).
Implement and validate the iterative functional-graph contraction and bottom-up DP, including self-loops, cycles, chains, and disconnected components.
